name: g8_cogntke_polecat_rule
registration_note: Written before CognTKE has been installed, trained or evaluated in this project: no CognTKE number on tkgl-polecat (valid or test, any arm) exists here. Known beforehand: published CognTKE polecat test MRR 0.287 / H@10 0.455 (run by the CountTRuCoLa authors, arXiv:2509.09474 Table 1, NVIDIA RTX A6000, total train+valid 417,600 s, test 7,548 s per Supplementary Table 11); all TiRGN/LogCL/RE-GCN polecat numbers of the hardening and pre-submission rounds (HRCOV_PAT TiRGN 0.28238, HRCOV TiRGN 0.28238, TiRGN better control POOL 0.23486).
question: On tkgl-polecat, does HRCOV (bridge-free coverage stack) improve the strongest published polecat model, CognTKE, beyond recurrency used well on that same base (BASE(+)RecB blend, RecB-POOL)?
dataset: tkgl-polecat (TGB 2.0, as shipped; N=150,931 entities, R=16 relations, test 532,636 queries over 304 timestamps)
protocol: TGB 2.0 single-step extrapolation, both query directions (inverse relation r+R), time-aware filtered 1-vs-all ranking, ground-truth online history before t; all 532,636 test queries; official py-tgb evaluator (ties 0.5).

code.model_class: models/TRED_GNN.py TRED_GNN20 (as selected by --model_name TRED_GNN in the released main.py)
code.train_mode: half (HalfTrainer, mixed precision, as in the README command)
allowed_changes: data loader reads the converted polecat files (entity2id/relation2id/train/valid/test in the released format)
torch_scatter replaced by a numerically equivalent pure-torch scatter shim only if the wheel cannot be installed for torch 2.8/cu128 (equivalence checked on random inputs before training)
per-epoch TEST evaluation disabled (selection uses valid only; the released code's best_weight logic keys on valid MRR, so selection is unchanged)
evaluation wrapped in torch.no_grad() (the released HalfTrainer writes `with torch.no_grad() and torch.cuda.amp.autocast()`, which applies autocast only; scores are unchanged, memory is reduced)
per-epoch checkpoint for resumability; score-row dump script added (reads the trained model, does not modify it)

base.training_data: train split only; history for valid/test queries = all facts with timestamp < t (train + earlier valid/test, ground-truth online), as in the released code
base.epoch_selection: epoch = argmax of full-valid MRR computed by the released code's own evaluation after every epoch (all valid queries, both directions, time-aware filter). No early stop beyond the released code's fixed epoch budget; no test number is read during training.

hyperparameters.source: CognTKE paper Appendix B.2 implementation details (the CountTRuCoLa supplement does not list CognTKE settings for TGB 2.0 datasets; it states only that the authors' code was run). Settings not stated in the paper take the released code's argparse defaults.
hyperparameters.recorded_conflicts: README command uses --n_layer 3; code defaults lr 0.005, time_dim 16. The paper values (n_layer 4, lr 0.001, time_dim 32) are used; if n_layer 4 does not fit 96 GB at batch 128 in the smoke, n_layer 3 (README) is used and recorded as a deviation BEFORE training. No hyper-parameter is tuned toward valid or test beyond this.
hyperparameters.budget_contingency: If the smoke projection exceeds 36 h on one RTX PRO 6000, the run is stopped and options (fewer epochs, reduced inference batch, valid evaluation cadence) are reported to the lead; any reduced budget is fixed from the cost projection alone, before any CognTKE valid/test MRR is read, and recorded as a deviation.

score_row_convention.primary: authors' row as produced: TRED_GNN20.forward fills reached entities with W_final(hidden) and leaves unreached entities at logit 0; the model is trained with softmax cross-entropy over this full row, so log p = log_softmax(row) over all 150,931 entities (fp16 autocast forward, cast to fp32 before log_softmax). Exact storage: reached ids + logits + per-query log-sum-exp (unreached share the logit 0).
reported_diagnostics: share of test queries whose gold entity is unreached (logit exactly 0, not in the reasoning subgraph)
mean/median number of reached entities per query
score_row_convention.sensitivity_not_in_decision: base-only official MRR with unreached entities at -inf (ties 0.5 among unreached under the official evaluator)

fidelity_check.rule: |official test MRR(CognTKE, ours) - 0.287| <= 0.010 -> BASE_FIDELITY_OK, else BASE_FIDELITY_LOW (flag only; the experiment still runs on our model; no tuning toward test).

claim_system.HRCOV: bridge-free coverage stack = HRCOV_PAT definition of the pre-submission round: pilot-1 recipe with base top-50 ++ first <= 50 pattern-prior candidates (pattern block B = pilot-1 setting as used for TiRGN polecat, pc_lists.py), W = 100, 25 features (8 base + 11 evidence + 6 pattern coverage; the 5 bridge features are not built), MLP 64-64 listwise CE, alpha*log p + beta*f calibrated on valid-select, seeds 0/1/2, early stopping on valid-select MRR; valid rows = pilot-1 200k valid sample (rng 12345) as for TiRGN polecat.
claim_system.HR: history re-ranker over base top-50 (pc_train.py arm HR, W = 50), seeds 0/1/2, same training discipline
claim_system.base_inputs: the base top-200 dump (BaseDump format) and exact base log-probs for every listed candidate are produced from the stored CognTKE rows; no other change to the pilot-1 pipeline.

comparators.BASE(+)RecB: as in hardening rule (ba7d388b): MIX beta in 13 values + LOGLIN w in {0.25,0.5,1,2} x eps in {1e-5,1e-3}, RecB variant {default, trained} (clean) = 42 configs; selected by valid MRR on the 200k valid sample; test scored once.
comparators.RecB-POOL: as in hardening rule: base top-K UNION RecB top-K, K in {20,50,100} x the 42 blend configs = 126 configs, ranked by the blended score, rest in base order; selected on valid; test scored once.
reference_rows_not_in_decision: RecB trained (clean) and default (clean/faithful) - existing hardening rows

statistic.evaluator: official py-tgb Evaluator per test query (negatives from the shipped tkgl-polecat_test_ns.pkl), system row = base row with the promoted list lifted above all other entities in fused order (pilot convention); harness exact ranks alongside (flag if MRR disagreement > 1e-4)
statistic.seeds: re-ranker per-query RR averaged over seeds 0,1,2
statistic.bootstrap: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over test queries, B = 2000, one-sided p = fraction of deltas <= 0; head stratum B = 1000

criteria.C1_margin: MRR(HRCOV_CognTKE) - MRR(C) >= 0.005 with one-sided p < 0.05 for C = CognTKE(+)RecB AND C = RecB-POOL_CognTKE (i.e. against each control).
criteria.C2_head_guardrail: HRCOV_CognTKE vs the better of the two controls on the head stratum (gold train frequency >= 500): DAMAGE iff 95% CI entirely below 0 and |delta| >= 0.001. Must not DAMAGE.

outcome_labels.RECURRENCY_DONE_WELL: C1 fails against at least one control

secondary_reported_not_in_decision: HRCOV_CognTKE - HRCOV_TiRGN (bridge-free HRCOV_PAT TiRGN polecat, official 0.28238; also vs HRCOV with bridge 0.28238), paired per query
HR_CognTKE vs controls and vs base
timestamp-block cluster bootstrap (304 test timestamps, B = 2000) for every decision delta (sensitivity; G7 convention)
base-only -inf-for-unreached convention; gold-unreached share; per-stratum deltas (pool-absent, R_rec_out, head/mid/cold)
selection_discipline: All blend weights, pool sizes, RecB variants, CognTKE epoch and re-ranker epochs/calibrations are chosen on VALID only. No test number is read before the full configuration (including the CognTKE checkpoint) is fixed; no configuration changes after a test number is read; post-hoc analyses are labelled post-hoc.
hosts: CognTKE train/inference: <HOST> GPU 0 only (GPU 1 never touched); CPU pipeline on <HOST> with <= 8 workers while Stage B/G2 run, or <HOST>. Work directory <SCRATCH>/open_ideas_harness/tracks/hardening/g8_cogntke/. Host of every number recorded.
